issues.description: The problem statement uses inconsistent method naming for the total-students method: a snake_case name 'get_total_number_of_students()' is mentioned in the prose, while the UML and test/task identifiers use the camelCase name 'getTotalNumberOfStudents()'. This inconsistency in the specification text may confuse students about the correct method name to implement and which name the tests expect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent throughout the problem statement and examples. Replace the snake_case reference with the camelCase name 'getTotalNumberOfStudents()' in the prose so it matches the UML, tests, and expected implementation.
